issues.description: The five checks cover ABI, CLI, and configuration parsing, but do not exercise syslog receive/write behavior. The PR discloses that daemon integration is outside the tested scope.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding an isolated temporary-socket daemon integration test in a future change.

summary: The CI traceability finding is resolved: PR_BODY states that #66662 and #66668 both reproduced the missing-bash configure failure and explains why the fix sets process SHELL and CONFIG_SHELL. The OHOS-only assignments occur before Autotools.configure(); Linux remains on the standard toolchain environment. No P0/P1 issues found. Current-head CI remains pending, so post-fix CI execution was not verified in this audit.
